content:
maya: Quick draft of release notes for tomorrow's micro-rollout. Targeting Hosted API v1.23.2, pinning runtime to rtxpool-2.
liam: Nice. Can we add a one-liner for Dedicated customers about reserved capacity changes?
maya: Yup — thinking: "Dedicated: minor scheduler tweak, no customer action required; expected <1% latency delta". good?
ops_jules: Add rollback criteria: if error rate > 2% for 10m, roll back to v1.23.1. We'll watch 00:00-04:00 UTC.
sophia: APAC embargo needs local hours note. Keep announcement internal until 08:00 PT, ok? :india: 
dana-prod: Staging smoke tests scheduled 22:30 PT. checklist:
- run `make smoke` on staging
- verify kv cache warmup
- validate stream responses

maya: Cool — I'm adding a short "What changed" section and a TOC. Draft snippet:
```
What changed:
- reduced TTFB for long-context chat (~10%) via KV cache prefetch
- small token counting fix for embeddings
- disabled experimental quant profile for gpt-open-8b
```
liam: Could we also include a "Notes for SRE" block with metrics + dashboard links?
maya: Adding SRE block with the two dashboards and the alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by @maya — staging -> canary -> prod. ETA 00:15 UTC. Watch /deployments/1728888888
ops_jules: I'll be oncall for the window. If canary latency > 200ms or errors spike, tag me and we roll back.
sophia: Publish internal announce at 08:15 PT to #all-hands, but keep external blast to 09:00 PT after quiet window.
dana-prod: Minor note — update Dedicated docs link. I'll paste after tests.
maya: Thanks all — I'll push final copy to the doc and ping when deploybot moves to canary. :thumbsup:
